tasks.label: Build NoteCore complet
tasks.command: cd frontend && npm run check && npm run build && rm -rf ../backend/frontenddist && cp -r dist ../backend/frontenddist && cd ../backend && wails build

tasks.label: Installer Wails et compiler NoteCore
tasks.command: go install github.com/wailsapp/wails/v2/cmd/wails@v2.10.2 && "$(go env GOPATH)/bin/wails" build

tasks.label: Compiler le binaire NoteCore
tasks.command: cd backend && "$(go env GOPATH)/bin/wails" build

tasks.label: Diagnostiquer environnement Go
tasks.command: go version && go env GOROOT GOPATH GOFLAGS GO111MODULE && cd backend && go test ./...

tasks.label: Compiler NoteCore sans régénérer les bindings
tasks.command: cd backend && "$(go env GOPATH)/bin/wails" build -skipbindings

tasks.label: Construire le binaire Go NoteCore
tasks.command: cd backend && mkdir -p build/bin && go build -o build/bin/notecore .

tasks.label: Trouver le tag Wails Linux
tasks.command: grep -R "correct build tags\|webkit2_" "$(go env GOPATH)/pkg/mod/github.com/wailsapp/wails/v2@v2.10.2" | head -40

tasks.label: Recompiler NoteCore avec le tag Wails
tasks.command: cd backend && go build -tags production -o build/bin/notecore .

tasks.label: Vérifier le frontend embarqué
tasks.command: grep -R -l "Le démarrage prend trop de temps" backend/frontenddist && grep -R -l "Ouverture de votre espace de travail" backend/frontenddist && strings backend/build/bin/notecore | grep -F "Le démarrage prend trop de temps" | head -1

tasks.label: Valider et reconstruire NoteCore
tasks.command: cd frontend && npm run check && npm run build && rm -rf ../backend/frontenddist && cp -r dist ../backend/frontenddist && cd ../backend && go build -tags production -o build/bin/notecore .

tasks.label: Diagnostiquer le runtime NoteCore
tasks.command: file backend/build/bin/notecore && ldd backend/build/bin/notecore | grep -E 'webkit|gtk|javascript|not found' && timeout 8s ./backend/build/bin/notecore; code=$?; echo "exit=$code"; pgrep -af notecore || true

tasks.label: Inspecter fenêtre NoteCore
tasks.command: echo "DISPLAY=$DISPLAY WAYLAND_DISPLAY=$WAYLAND_DISPLAY"; pgrep -af notecore || true; (command -v wmctrl >/dev/null && wmctrl -l || true); (command -v xdotool >/dev/null && xdotool search --name NoteCore getwindowname %@ || true); (command -v xwininfo >/dev/null && xwininfo -root -tree | grep -i -E 'note|wails|webkit' || true)

tasks.label: Tracer le démarrage NoteCore
tasks.command: if command -v strace >/dev/null; then timeout 5s strace -f -e trace=openat,connect,write -o /tmp/notecore.strace ./backend/build/bin/notecore || true; grep -E 'notecore.db|frontenddist|index|webkit|gtk|ENOENT|EACCES' /tmp/notecore.strace | tail -60; else echo 'strace indisponible'; fi

tasks.label: Lister les fenêtres X11
tasks.command: command -v xprop || true; if command -v xprop >/dev/null; then xprop -root _NET_CLIENT_LIST_STACKING 2>&1; xprop -root _NET_CLIENT_LIST 2>&1; fi; command -v gdb || true

tasks.label: Inspecter la fenêtre X11
tasks.command: xprop -id 0x120000c 2>&1 | grep -E 'WM_NAME|_NET_WM_NAME|_NET_WM_STATE|WM_CLASS|_NET_WM_PID|_NET_FRAME_EXTENTS|_NET_WM_WINDOW_TYPE'

tasks.label: Capturer la stack NoteCore
tasks.command: pid=$(pgrep -xo notecore); if [ -n "$pid" ]; then echo "pid=$pid"; gdb -q -batch -ex 'thread apply all bt' -p "$pid" 2>&1 | tail -160; else echo 'notecore absent'; fi

tasks.label: Lire l’état système NoteCore
tasks.command: pid=$(pgrep -xo notecore); echo "pid=$pid"; cat /proc/$pid/wchan 2>/dev/null || true; grep -E 'State|Threads|VmRSS|voluntary_ctxt|nonvoluntary' /proc/$pid/status 2>/dev/null || true; echo 'open files:'; ls -l /proc/$pid/fd 2>/dev/null | tail -30; echo 'db files:'; find "$HOME/.config/NoteCore" -maxdepth 1 -type f -printf '%f %s bytes\n' 2>/dev/null || true

tasks.label: Tracer la création de fenêtre GTK
tasks.command: timeout 4s env WAYLAND_DEBUG=1 ./backend/build/bin/notecore 2>&1 | grep -E 'xdg_toplevel|xdg_surface|wl_surface|gtk|error|failed' | tail -80 || true

tasks.label: Vérifier outils de capture écran
tasks.command: for tool in grim gnome-screenshot scrot spectacle import; do if command -v "$tool" >/dev/null; then echo "$tool=$(command -v $tool)"; fi; done; echo 'compositor:'; printf 'XDG_CURRENT_DESKTOP=%s\n' "$XDG_CURRENT_DESKTOP"; printf 'WAYLAND_DISPLAY=%s\n' "$WAYLAND_DISPLAY"

tasks.label: Capturer le bureau Wayland
tasks.command: spectacle -b -n -f -o /tmp/notecore-screen.png && file /tmp/notecore-screen.png

tasks.label: Inspecter les options Wails
tasks.command: grep -R "type App struct\|StartHidden\|HideWindow" "$(go env GOPATH)/pkg/mod/github.com/wailsapp/wails/v2@v2.10.2/pkg/options" "$(go env GOPATH)/pkg/mod/github.com/wailsapp/wails/v2@v2.10.2/internal" | head -80

tasks.label: Confirmer le titre Wayland
tasks.command: timeout 2s env WAYLAND_DEBUG=1 ./backend/build/bin/notecore 2>&1 | grep -E 'set_title|set_app_id|xdg_toplevel' | head -30 || true

tasks.label: Interroger KWin
tasks.command: for cmd in qdbus qdbus6; do if command -v "$cmd" >/dev/null; then echo "[$cmd]"; "$cmd" org.kde.KWin /KWin 2>&1 | head -80; fi; done

tasks.label: Lire la fenêtre active KDE
tasks.command: qdbus6 org.kde.KWin /KWin org.kde.KWin.currentDesktop; qdbus6 org.kde.KWin /KWin org.kde.KWin.activeOutputName; qdbus6 org.kde.KWin /KWin org.kde.KWin.queryWindowInfo 2>&1 | head -100

tasks.label: Tracer les appels Wails au démarrage
tasks.command: cd backend && go test ./... && go build -tags production -o build/bin/notecore . && timeout 6s ./build/bin/notecore 2>&1 || true

tasks.label: Valider le démarrage corrigé
tasks.command: cd frontend && npm run check && npm run build && rm -rf ../backend/frontenddist && cp -r dist ../backend/frontenddist && cd ../backend && go build -tags production -o build/bin/notecore . && timeout 6s ./build/bin/notecore 2>&1 || true

tasks.label: Build propre final NoteCore

tasks.label: Vérifier le frontend NoteCore
tasks.command: cd frontend && npm run check && npm run build

tasks.label: Embarquer le correctif et compiler
tasks.command: rm -rf backend/frontenddist && cp -r frontend/dist backend/frontenddist && cd backend && go test ./... && go build -tags production -o build/bin/notecore .

tasks.label: Lancer NoteCore pour inspection
tasks.command: ./backend/build/bin/notecore

tasks.label: Inspecter NoteCore dans KWin
tasks.command: qdbus6 org.kde.KWin /KWin org.kde.KWin.queryWindowInfo 2>&1 | grep -E 'caption:|pid:|resourceClass:|width:|height:|minimized:|desktops:'; pgrep -af notecore

tasks.label: Capturer NoteCore à l'écran
tasks.command: spectacle -b -n -f -o /tmp/notecore-current.png && file /tmp/notecore-current.png

tasks.label: Inspecter le code embarqué du boot

tasks.label: Tester le contrat des listes vides

tasks.command: spectacle -b -n -f -o /tmp/notecore-icon.png && file /tmp/notecore-icon.png
